title: Full-time 4x4 transfer case: shift linkage adjustment (1976-77 Dodge W trucks)
summary: Army procedure for re-indexing the two shift rods on the five-position (HI LOC, HI, N, LO, LO LOC) transfer case lever with an 11/64-inch alignment rod.
warnings: From the Army manual for the M880 (military 1976-77 Dodge W200). Confirm a civilian truck has the same part before using a number.

specs.name: Lever positions
specs.value: HI LOC, HI, N, LO, LO LOC

specs.name: Max speed in LO with transmission in 1
Max speed in LO with transmission in 2 or D

steps.text: Put the transfer shift lever in HI.
Loosen both swivel rod clamp lockscrews at the shifter assembly so both rods slide freely in their swivels.
Move the cab shift lever to N and push an 11/64-inch rod through the alignment holes in the shifter housing.
Put the range shift linkage (outside lever) in neutral, with the lockout shift lever in unlock.
Tighten the swivel rod clamp lockscrews to 11 ft-lb.
Pull the alignment rod out and cycle the shift lever through every position to check it.
